notes.title: End them, Soldier! Release Date
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600889/1d4ef042f398f41769829d041940a81d19a92117.png"]
End Them, Soldier! is almost there!


The time is near! End Them, Soldier! is entering the final stretch of development. On November 7, 2025, you’ll finally face the relentless hordes unleashed on Earth by the Terralith energy.

Also, there is a new Release Date Trailer with some new gameplay episodes and highly variable perk-system shown in it.
[previewyoutube="1Mk02EYCbdo;full"][/previewyoutube]
I’ve almost completed all the major work on the game:

All campaign and "master" levels are finished.

Rogue-like game mode is fully playable with online leaderboard to check your place among other players (and me, I play it a lot).

Weapon and ability balance fine-tuned for maximum intensity. But it's always a place for future balance patches ;)

Final polish to visuals, sound, and animations is almost done aswell.

Hope you'll like the game as much as I do.

Be prepared to slay all the hordes of undead on November 7, 2025.
